description: W2 ∞-side: ramification of the C1 q-difference module. Slope ½ at ∞ makes the companion nilpotent, so no leading block is readable. Ramifying with index 2 (x=z², q=p²) integralises the slope to 1 and yields the edge polynomial p⁴T² −(p²−1), whose roots are the two leading blocks B₁,₂ = ±√(q−1)/q. These index the two Stokes sectors; the multipliers themselves still need the q-Borel/theta resummation.
